explanationBullets: Advanced troubleshooting is the right path when forwarding still fails or when the network may be blocked by double NAT, CGNAT, or ISP restrictions.
Use the advanced troubleshooting path for double NAT, CGNAT, wrong-router configuration, firewall blocks, or ISP restrictions.

notes: wantsAdvancedTroubleshooting short-circuits resolve() before the search query or networkType (deliberately set to mesh_system here) are ever consulted — the very first check in the function, unconditional.
